releaseNotes: Full teacher control. Manage any teacher on the console: role or a custom post (DOS, Deputy Head, Bursar, or anything you type), class teacher of, classes taught, subjects taught, extra duties from a preset list or your own wording, access on/off, and their activity. Teachers scan the school code, tap Find my name, choose themselves, and get their classes and duties. Both apps now ask you to update on launch.
